title: Elimination of radiation‐induced senescent cancer cells and stromal cells in vitro by near‐infrared photoimmunotherapy
abstract: Therapy‐induced senescent cancer and stromal cells secrete cytokines and growth factors to promote tumor progression. Therefore, senescent cells may be novel targets for tumor treatment. Near‐infrared photoimmunotherapy (NIR‐PIT) is a highly tumor‐selective therapy that employs conjugates of a molecular‐targeting antibody and photoabsorber. Thus, NIR‐PIT has the potential to be applied as a novel senolytic therapy. This study aims to investigate the efficacy of NIR‐PIT treatment on senescent cancer and stromal cells.
